ei.title: Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

fullPassage:
Suwon Hwaseong: A Fusion of Defenses and Daily Life

Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.

Historically, the sanseong served as the final defense against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could fight from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century.

Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and poor living conditions though. So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong, such as Naganeupseong and Haemieupseong. Surrounded by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, lived outside these walls. In times of war, they withdrew to the nearby sanseong for safety.

After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress emerged that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. Built along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also serving as a center for agriculture, commerce, and housing.

questions.passage: Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its uniqueness often goes ①<u>unnoticed</u>. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress ②<u>knowing</u> as eupseong. Historically, the sanseong ③<u>served</u> as the final defense against invaders by ④<u>utilizing</u> Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①주목받지 못한 ②~로 알려진(known) ③역할했다 ④활용하며
det.analysis:
✅ ② knowing → known: 'known as ~' = ~로 알려진. 과거분사(known)가 명사 fortress를 수식해야 함. knowing은 현재분사로 '알고 있는'이 되어 의미 부적합
❌ ①③④: 모두 적절
det.tip: known as = ~로 알려진 (과거분사) / knowing = 알고 있는 (현재분사)

questions.passage: Defenders could fight from ①<u>higher</u> ground and effectively push back enemies with ②<u>fewer</u> soldiers. A famous example of this advantage was the battle at Haengjusanseong during the Japanese invasion of Korea in the late 16th century. Living in the sanseong was not practical due to ③<u>scarcely</u> farmland and ④<u>poor</u> living conditions though.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①더 높은 ②더 적은 ③부족한(scarce) ④열악한
det.analysis:
✅ ③ scarcely(부사) → scarce(형용사): 명사 farmland를 수식하므로 형용사 scarce 필요
❌ ①②④: 모두 적절
det.tip: scarce(형용사: 부족한) vs scarcely(부사: 거의 ~않게) — 명사 앞에는 형용사

questions.passage: So during peaceful times, people lived in and around the eupseong. ①<u>Surrounding</u> by low walls, the area housed administrative buildings, learning centers, and training grounds for soldiers. Common people, mainly farmers, ②<u>lived</u> outside these walls. In times of war, they ③<u>withdrew</u> to the nearby sanseong for ④<u>safety</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①둘러싸인(Surrounded) ②살았다 ③철수했다 ④안전
det.analysis:
✅ ① Surrounding → Surrounded: the area가 벽에 '둘러싸인' 것이므로 과거분사(수동) 필요
❌ ②③④: 모두 적절
det.tip: Surrounded by = ~에 의해 둘러싸인 (수동 분사구문) / Surrounding = 둘러싸고 있는 (능동)

questions.passage: After the Japanese invasion, a new type of fortress ①<u>emerged</u> that combined the strengths of both the sanseong and the eupseong. ②<u>Built</u> along the natural slopes of Paldalsan Mountain, Suwon Hwaseong displayed strong walls and defenses while also ③<u>serving</u> as a center for agriculture, commerce, and ④<u>house</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①등장했다 ②건설된 ③역할하며 ④주거(housing)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ house → housing: agriculture, commerce와 병렬구조로 명사 필요. house는 '집'이지만 여기서는 '주거'의 의미로 housing이 원문
❌ ①②③: 모두 적절
det.tip: house(명사: 집, 동사: 수용하다) vs housing(명사: 주거, 주택) — 병렬구조: agriculture, commerce, and housing

questions.passage: Suwon Hwaseong stands proudly as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, but its __________ often goes unnoticed. This fortress artfully blends two distinct Korean styles: the mountain fortress, or sanseong, and the flat-land fortress known as eupseong.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수원 화성의 독특함(uniqueness)은 종종 주목받지 못한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② uniqueness: 'but'으로 역접 + 'goes unnoticed' = 독특함이 주목받지 못함
❌ ① heritage(유산): UNESCO 지위는 but 앞에 언급됨
❌ ③ landscape(지형): 주목받지 못하는 것은 지형이 아님
❌ ④ fortress(요새): 요새 자체가 아닌 그 독특함
det.tip: uniqueness = 독특함 / goes unnoticed = 주목받지 못하다

questions.passage: Historically, the sanseong served as the final ①<u>defense</u> against invaders by utilizing Korea's mountainous landscape to its advantage. Defenders could ②<u>fight</u> from higher ground and effectively push back enemies with fewer soldiers. Living in the sanseong was not practical due to scarce farmland and ③<u>excellent</u> living conditions though. So during ④<u>peaceful</u> times, people lived in and around the eupseong.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①방어 ②싸우다 ③(훌륭한→)열악한(poor) ④평화로운
det.analysis:
✅ ③ excellent(훌륭한) → poor(열악한): 산성 생활이 비실용적인 이유가 '부족한 농경지'와 '열악한 생활 조건'이므로 excellent은 부적절
❌ ①②④: 모두 원문 그대로 적절
det.tip: poor living conditions(열악한 생활 조건) ↔ excellent living conditions(훌륭한 생활 조건)
